items.name: Airlie Oak Wilmington Printed Mug
items.alt: Ceramic mug printed with a painterly illustration of the Airlie Oak, a Southern live oak with hanging Spanish moss and blush azaleas at its base, on a weathered garden bench with azaleas and a live oak behind, shown as an illustrative image
items.meta: A printed 11 oz ceramic mug with a painterly illustration of the Airlie Oak, the roughly 500 year old Southern live oak at Airlie Gardens in Wilmington NC, with Spanish moss and blush azaleas. Made to order.
facts: Airlie Oak illustration on the front of the mug
